event.title: Networking for a Cause
event.description: Join us in New York City at the RSM offices for an evening of networking in support of Baal Dan's work with vulnerable children worldwide.

news.title: Light from the Lighthouse!
news.body: Children with special needs in South Africa are receiving daily meals, uniforms and supplies through the Lighthouse Center, where even $5 has significant purchasing power.

news.title: Happy Mother's Day!
news.body: With partner ASDEPO in Ethiopia, we're delivering food ration kits to mothers of severely malnourished children. Tanya shares what it meant to meet these mothers in person.

news.title: Helping children in Nepal
news.body: 60 children with multiple disabilities in Bhaktapur now receive nutritious meals, medical care, and activities like music therapy and computer classes through CBR.

news.title: Save the Date! Wednesday, September 23, 2026
news.body: We're excited to announce our upcoming Networking for a Cause event in New York City at the RSM offices.

news.title: Where does your money go? Nepal Audit
news.body: David Grisanti's independent verification visit confirms proper fund allocation to our Nepal grantee partners, marking Baal Dan's 21st anniversary.

news.title: Thank you to our Baal Dan Luminaries!
news.body: Recognizing the generous donors who contributed $1,000 or more to support children's food, education and supplies this year.

news.title: Happy Valentine's Day!
news.body: A special appeal for $14+ donations to support children with special needs at the Lighthouse Center in South Africa.

news.title: What works in humanitarian aid?
news.body: Citing humanitarian expert David Miliband, we look at how simplified malnutrition treatment and transparent reporting drive real results across our four core countries.

news.title: We need more monthly donors!
news.body: Recurring gifts give our grantee partners the year-round funding stability they need to plan ahead for the children in their care.

news.title: Thank you Sir Mark Tully for being the "voice of India"
news.body: A tribute to the legendary BBC broadcaster, reflecting on his opening of the Turkahan School and his advice to keep sharing children's stories.
